separation_of_concerns.control_cpu: CPU command issue is tested without the systolic array RTL; completion and ready are C++/DPI-driven inputs.
separation_of_concerns.ingress_sram: The stream buffer is the explicit latched boundary between Ethernet ingress and the array input stream.
separation_of_concerns.systolic_array: The array is tested without CPU RTL; command and input streams are C++/DPI-driven inputs.
